Communication is key when it comes to healthy relationships. When writing professionals e-mails, it is important to use friendly language that will keep you and your co-workers on good terms. Here's some language you can use to:

1. Make a friendly start
    • Hi Leo,
    • Morning Jonathan,
    • Hello Mike,
    • Mary,
    • I hope you're well / I hope you're enjoying the nice weather.
    • I hope you're having a good week.


  2. Follow up after a contact
    • Thank you for your kind e-mail.
    • Thank you for your hospitality.
    • It was good seeing you!
    • It was great to see you yesterday.


  3. Show interest & share information
    • Hope you had a good trip/vacation /weekend/ holiday.
    • Hope you're not working too hard.
    • How are things in Toronto/Colombia?
    • I've just got back from a trip to South America and it was amazing!


  4. End the e-mail
    • Looking forward to seeing you /meeting you /hearing from you.
    • Have a safe/good flight.
    • Enjoy your stay /trip /conference.


  5. Sign off
    • Best wishes
    • Best regards
    • Best
    • Thanks
    • Thanks for everything
    • Take care
When writing professional emails, you will often need to use the Present Perfect or the Past Simple. Here are some ways in which you can use them.

1. Use the Past Simple to talk about a completed action in the past. The time is usually obvious from the context.
    I also confirmed a hotel downtown with Peter.


  2. Use the Past Simple (with a present meaning) when you want to be more polite.
    I just wanted to let you know that someone will pick you up at 9 am.


  3. Use the Present Perfect to talk about a past action which has an effect in the present.
    He's booked a hotel downtown for you and has made reservations at your favourite restaurant.
    He's sent me the new clothing designs.


  4. Use the Present Perfect to talk about an action we expected to be completed but hasn't been.Have you packed your bags yet?
    Let's talk about when you've had a chance to take a look at them.

Subject: Arrangements for your trip and Farmani's new clothing line

Hi Ferdinand,

How are you? I hope you're well and you've had a good week. Have you visited the shops yet?
Anyway, back to work. I just wanted to let you know that Polygon's driver will pick you up at the airport at 9 am and drop you off at the hotel at approximately 9.30 am. I also confirmed with Peter that he's booked a hotel downtown and made a reservation at your favourite Colombian restaurant - El Trompo.

By the way, Farmani has sent me the new designs for the clothing line. They look fabulous! Please find them attached to this email. We can discuss them in depth when you've had a chance to look them over.
Looking forward to chatting with you. Have a good flight.

All the best,
Miranda

Subject: Thank you

Hi Miranda,
Thank you for your kind email.
I hope you're enjoying fall in Boston. And I really hope you're not working too hard.
I appreciate you taking care of the last-minute details. I am still in Panama waiting for my connecting flight to Colombia. By the way, I can't wait to have a real Colombian meal! I'm tired of eating frozen dinners so often!
Anyway, I will be happy to look over the designs. I know this trip will be very productive.
Thanks again for everything.

Ferdinand
